description_en: Disassociates a whitelist template from an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于取消关联的白名单模板与实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds detach-whitelist-template-to-instance --template-id 412 --ins-name rm-bp191w771k000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachWhitelistTemplateToInstance

parameters.help_en: The whitelist template ID. You can call DescribeAllWhitelistTemplate to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 白名单模板ID。可通过DescribeAllWhitelistTemplate获取
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610399.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see What is a resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。 关于资源组的更多信息，请参见什么是资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id
